rising_new_repos_30d.description: Claude Code plugin: stops Claude before your usage limit and saves a checked handoff note, so a new chat picks up where it left off.
rising_new_repos_30d.readme_excerpt: # auto-pause > [!IMPORTANT] > **This plugin was written entirely by AI.** All of its code, tests and documentation were written by Claude (Anthropic's AI) in Claude Code. I am not a programmer. What I did: > > - Came up with the idea on my own, before I knew any similar plugins existed. > - Gathered the outside research on similar plugins that shaped the design. > - Decided what the plugin should do, reviewed the work, and edited this README. Claude has two usage limits: one resets every 5 hours, the other every week. When you get close to one, this plugin makes Claude stop at a good moment and save a note (Claude calls it a "handoff") about where it left off, and give you a resume prompt to copy. After the limit resets, you paste the resume prompt into a new chat session and Claude carries on. ## How this plugin helps - You don't lose work halfway. Without it, Claude can hit the limit in the middle of a change and leave files half-edited, with no record of what it was doing. - A fresh chat uses less of your new limit. Claude's short-term memory of a chat (the "cache") runs out after an hour, so continuing the old chat after the reset makes it re-read the whole conversation at full
